load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained transformer model from a HuggingFace model ID or local directory using PreTrainedModel.from_pretrained
save_pretrained_model: save a transformer model and its config to a directory using PreTrainedModel.save_pretrained
resize_token_embeddings: resize the input token embeddings of a pretrained model to a new vocabulary size
prune_attention_heads: prune specific attention heads in selected layers of a transformer model using prune_heads
compute_sequence_summary: compute a single vector summary of sequence hidden states using SequenceSummary with last, first, mean, or cls_index methods
